metadata.title: Email Application – Bi‑Directional SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing application-controlled email that both sends and receives messages via a dedicated mailbox, with fully automated processing and no human interactive login.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security, privacy, records, and risk baseline.

system-characteristics.system-description: Dedicated application mailbox service used for automated inbound message processing and outbound responses (e.g., helpdesk ticket creation and notifications), with strict isolation, parsing controls, and automated-only access.

information-type.title: Inbound Application Email Content
information-type.description: Email messages received by the application mailbox for automated processing, including headers, body, and attachments.

information-type.title: Outbound Application Email Content
information-type.description: Automated responses and notifications generated by the application in reply to inbound messages.

information-type.title: Email Parsing and Processing State
information-type.description: Parsed fields, normalized content, and derived artifacts produced by automated ingestion pipelines.

information-type.title: Application Email Audit Events
information-type.description: Audit records for message receipt, parsing outcomes, policy enforcement, throttling, and outbound dispatch.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: This service inherits transport security, monitoring, and resilience from the Secure Email Platform SSPP.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Uses core email transport, authentication, and routing controls.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Uses strict domain and sender identity binding for application mail.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Inbound and outbound email is subject to malware, phishing, and abuse protection.

props.name: usage-intent
props.remarks: This service exists solely to enable automated application email ingestion and automated responses.

props.name: mailbox-type
props.remarks: Each application uses a dedicated mailbox not shared with humans or other applications.

props.name: access-model
props.remarks: Interactive human login, mailbox delegation, and human mailbox access are strictly prohibited.

props.name: authentication-model
props.remarks: Mailbox access is restricted to non-human application identities using approved service authentication.

props.name: directionality
props.remarks: The mailbox both receives inbound email and sends automated outbound responses.

props.name: reply-model
props.remarks: All outbound responses are generated automatically by application logic.

props.name: sender-identity-model
props.remarks: Outbound messages clearly identify the sending application and are not attributable to individual humans.

props.name: recipient-scope
props.remarks: Inbound recipients are restricted to the dedicated application address; outbound recipients are limited to the scope defined by application function.

props.name: external-recipient-policy
props.remarks: External senders may submit inbound email only where explicitly required by application purpose (e.g., customer support).

props.name: parsing-safety
props.remarks: Inbound email content MUST be defensively parsed with strict validation, normalization, and rejection of malformed or unexpected input.

props.name: attachment-handling
props.remarks: Attachments are restricted, scanned, size-limited, and normalized prior to any processing.

props.name: automation-constraint
props.remarks: Delegated access and forwarding rules are prohibited.

props.name: data-classification-constraint
props.remarks: Application bi-directional email MUST NOT process information classified at Level 4 or higher.

props.name: information-use-constraint
props.remarks: Email content is transient input/output and must not be treated as a system of record.

props.name: security-enforcement-scope
props.remarks: Inbound and outbound messages may be blocked, quarantined, sanitized, or withdrawn if malicious or abusive activity is detected.

props.name: auditability
props.remarks: All email activity must be attributable to the specific application identity and processing context.

system-implementation.remarks: The service operates as a controlled ingress/egress email interface with automated parsing pipelines, strict identity enforcement, and robust threat protection.

components.title: Application Bi‑Directional Email Mailbox
components.description: Dedicated mailbox interfacing automated email ingestion and response workflows.

roles.title: Application Owner
roles.remarks: Accountable for defining email use cases, recipient scope, parsing behavior, and business logic.

control-implementation.remarks: All applicable controls are inherited from Secure Email Platform SSPP and associated email patterns, with additional constraints for automated inbound processing and application identity assurance.
